slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
“轰隆！”
星空尽头，帝关之上。
只见一道伟岸的身影屹立在顶端。
他身着一袭玄袍，身形修长，英姿勃发，面容俊朗，浑身散发着虚无缥缈的混沌气息，宛若传说中的混沌体……
“轰！”
在他的周围。
数十具尸体漂泊星空。
这些尸体当中有太古族的，也有圣灵族的，甚至还有神族、昆仑仙族，他们无一例外全都散发着无比恐怖的气息……
哪怕死了。
他们的威势依旧难以想象。
这十多具尸体全都是真正的准皇强者！
“终于到这一天了吗？”
“证道…”
林昭轻轻叹息。
他平静的漫步在星空尽头，炽热的眸光看向了天穹上方，眼底闪烁着浓郁的战意，一身混沌气息包罗万象，横空镇压天地万道……
四百年前。
林昭意外穿越到了遮天世界，随后降生于北斗葬帝星，以一介凡体踏上了修行之路。
如今正处于太古时代。
五千年前。
黄金古皇自斩一刀。

他舍弃天心印记进入太初古矿。
至此，天地间充满了属于黄金古皇的大道压制。
在这个时代。
林昭不仅修炼极其艰难。
甚至他在整个修行界都寸步难行。
因为。
这里是太古时代。
如果是其他生命古星也就罢了，偏偏林昭降生的是北斗葬帝星，这个时期的北斗是太古万族的天下，人族在太古万族的眼中不过是奴隶、血食罢了。
因此。
林昭在修行界寸步难行。
所幸，他意外得到了太阴、太阳两位人皇的古经，最终同修阴阳，走出了属于自己的道路，逆天演化出后天混沌体，强行顶着太古万族的压迫一步步走到了今日……
不久前。
各大势力出动底蕴前来围杀他。
足足十二尊准皇。
但最后全都被他击毙了。
林昭修炼了四百年。
他只用了短短四百年就走到了准九大圆满，要知道……
如今正处于大道压制的状态啊。
在道艰时代修至准九大圆满。
由此足以看出他的强大。

“世间一直都流传着五百年内不能证道的魔咒。”
“今日。”
“便让我来打破这一魔咒！”
林昭缓缓抬眸，他看向天穹上方属于黄金古皇的大道压制，随后毫不犹豫的引动了成道劫。
content_en:
"Boom!"
At the end of the starry sky, above the Imperial Pass.
I saw a majestic figure standing at the top.
Wearing a mysterious robe, he has a slender figure, a heroic figure, and a handsome face. He exudes an ethereal aura of chaos, just like the legendary chaotic body...
"Boom!"
around him.
Dozens of corpses drift in the starry sky.
Among these corpses are those from the Ancient Clan, the Holy Spirit Clan, and even the God Clan and the Kunlun Clan. Without exception, they all exude an extremely terrifying aura...
Even if you die.
Their power is still unimaginable.
These more than ten corpses are all true quasi-emperors!
"Has the day finally come?"
"Proof..."
Lin Zhao sighed softly.
He walked calmly at the end of the starry sky, looking at the top of the sky with fiery eyes, his eyes flashing with strong fighting spirit, and his aura of chaos encompassed everything, suppressing all the ways of heaven and earth...
Four hundred years ago.
Lin Zhao accidentally traveled to the world of Zhetian, and then was born on the Beidou Emperor Burial Star, and embarked on the path of cultivation in a mortal body.
We are now in the ancient times.
Five thousand years ago.
The ancient golden emperor cut himself with a knife.
He abandoned the Tianxin Seal and entered the Taichu Ancient Mine.
At this point, the world is filled with the suppression of the avenue belonging to the Golden Ancient Emperor.
In this era.
Not only was Lin Zhao's cultivation extremely difficult.
He even found it difficult to move forward in the entire spiritual world.
because.
This is ancient times.
It would be fine if it was another ancient life star, but Lin Zhao was born on the Beidou Emperor Burial Star. During this period, Beidou was dominated by the ancient tribes. In the eyes of the ancient tribes, the human race was nothing more than slaves and blood-eaters.
therefore.
Lin Zhao could not move forward in the world of spiritual practice.
Fortunately, he accidentally obtained the ancient scriptures of the two human emperors, Taiyin and Sun. Finally, he practiced Yin and Yang together, walked out on his own path, and evolved into the acquired chaotic body against the sky. He forcibly withstood the oppression of the ancient races and walked step by step to today...
Not long ago.
All the major forces mobilized their information to surround and kill him.
A total of twelve quasi-emperors.
But in the end they were all killed by him.
Lin Zhao has been practicing for four hundred years.
It only took him just four hundred years to reach the quasi-nine great perfections. You know...
Now we are in a state of suppression.
Cultivation to the nine great perfections in the difficult times.
This is enough to show how powerful he is.
"There has always been a curse circulating in the world that prevents enlightenment within five hundred years."
"Today."
"Let me break this curse!"
Lin Zhao slowly raised his eyes, he looked at the Dao Suppression belonging to the Golden Ancient Emperor above the sky, and then triggered the Initiation Tribulation without hesitation.
